geometry: Central winged wolf head facing forward; set against a backdrop of a luminous aurora; rectangular stone border with runes
color_palette: Ethereal violet, magenta, and cyan for the aurora; translucent ice-blue wolf; glowing cyan for the runes and lightning
symbolism: The winged wolf represents spiritual ascension, freedom, and the guiding light of the northern or southern cosmic poles
cultural_hints: A contemplative and unified society that values harmony with celestial phenomena and the spiritual protection of their kin
distinctive_traits: The wolf head has a ghostly, crystalline appearance that blends into the shimmering curtains of the background aurora
